title: Tech Note: Getting an XML Element's Full Path
author: David Adams

historical_commentary.text: This note adds a DOM_GetFullPath routine that walks upward from an XML node to its root to build a slash-delimited path string, filling a gap left by the native DOM Find XML element command which requires the path to already be known. It is tightly bound to 4D's classic pre-v11, pre-JSON DOM XML command set; the specific commands are legacy today, but the general technique of building a bottom-up path string via parent traversal is a timeless tree-processing pattern still applicable to any hierarchical data structure.
related_updates: 4D added native JSON support and other modern data-interchange handling in later versions, reducing reliance on the classic DOM XML command set for new development
The DOM XML commands referenced remain available for backward compatibility
